shots.headline: Кофейня у гавани
shots.sub: Заказы, бариста и очередь у прилавка
shots.scene: Corner Cafe at the morning peak (~08:00): 6+ tickets on the rail, 3 baristas on espresso and steam, a queue at the counter, HUD visible, guide finished, Medium tier

shots.headline: Выберите следующий заказ
shots.sub: Сначала срочные, первые или постоянные клиенты
shots.scene: House rule sheet open over the bar: Deadline first selected, one ticket flagged Priority, a pre-order with its pickup time on the rail

shots.headline: Настройте идеальный эспрессо
shots.scene: Grinder held mid dial-in: the tune meter climbing back into the green, 'Grinder dialled in' toast, espresso machine pulling a shot

shots.headline: Дождь или жара? Планируйте
shots.sub: Готовьте горячие напитки или лёд заранее
shots.scene: Morning plan with the forecast strip showing rain tomorrow and the Prep hot drinks card (urn) open; the cart under its awning in the background

shots.headline: Обжаривайте свои зёрна
shots.scene: Roastery tab: drum roaster running, the progress bar inside the 70-86 % sweet spot, 'First crack! Drop now' marker, green coffee market below

shots.headline: Продавайте зёрна оптом
shots.sub: Контракты с Harbour Bistro и Ferry Kiosk
shots.scene: Wholesale list with the Harbour Bistro contract signed (kg / every N days / quality), house beans quality 85+, resting racks filled

shots.headline: От тележки до цеха
shots.scene: Grow tab: Quayside Cart and Corner Cafe owned as branches with their daily income, Roastery Hall open; the roastery diorama behind

shots.headline: Отзывы на пять звёзд

shots.scene: Day report after a strong roastery day: average review near 5 stars, served / walk-out numbers, sales and net, Collect button (no reward-video button in frame)
